extracted.intended_audience: grant applicants and institutional staff using ASSIST to prepare NIH/SAMHSA grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for completing application forms in the ASSIST system (NIH/SAMHSA), including required attachments, budgets, personnel profiles, site locations, and specific form requirements for FORMS-I. Focused on correctly populating fields, attachments, and procedural steps needed for successful submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Abstract Summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Your total abstract must not be longer than 30 lines. It should include the project name, population(s) to be served (demographics and clinical characteristics), strategies/interventions, project goals and measurable objectives, including the number of people to be served annually and throughout the lifetime of the project, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the first five lines or less of your abstract, write a summary of your project that can be used, if your project is funded, in publications, reports to Congress, or press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Narrative (detail & justification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must include a detailed Budget Narrative in addition to the Budget Form SF-424A.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To determine whether costs are allowable, allocable, and reasonable, explain how each of the budgeted amounts was determined. Provide specific detail for: Personnel - describe the role and responsibilities of each position; Fringe Benefits - list all components of the fringe benefit rate; Travel - provide (if applicable) airfare per staff, # of staff attending each meeting, lodging per staff, # of days, per diem rate, mileage, etc.; Supplies - describe need if not self-explanatory; Contractual - explain the need for each contractual arrangement and how these components relate to the overall project; Other - each category must be listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project/Performance Site Location(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collect location information on the site(s) where work funded under this grant announcement will be performed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary Performance Site: click Edit to enable, optionally Populate from this component's R&R Cover to auto-populate fields, complete required fields (marked with *), and save using available save options. To add additional sites, use Add Site; populate from R&R Cover optionally; required fields are marked with *; use Save and Keep, Save and Release Lock, or Save and Add as appropriate. Edit, Remove, and View buttons are provided to manage locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Narrative (implementation and objectives)
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must address how the applicant will implement and meet the goals and objectives of the program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must attach their project narrative file (Adobe PDF format only) inside the Project Narrative Attachment Form. See the NOFO: Part I for specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: SF-LLL (Disclosure of Lobbying Activities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal law prohibits the use of appropriated funds for publicity or propaganda purposes or for the preparation, distribution, or use of the information designed to support or defeat legislation pending before Congress or state legislatures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must sign and submit this form, if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketches (required content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Existing curricula vitae may be used if updated and contain all items of information requested below. For development of new curricula vitae include items below in the most suitable format:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required items: 1) Name of staff member; 2) Educational background: school(s), location, dates attended, degrees earned (specify year), major field of study; 3) Professional experience; 4) Honors received and dates; 5) Recent relevant publications; 6) Other sources of support [defined as all funds or resources, whether federal, non-federal, or institutional, available to the PD/PI (and other key personnel) in direct support of their activities through grants, cooperative agreements, contracts, fellowships, gifts, prizes, and other means].

rubrics_metrics.name: Job Description (required content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Job descriptions must include specific items to describe positions supporting the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required items to include: 1) Title of position; 2) Description of duties and responsibilities; 3) Qualifications for position; 4) Supervisory relationships; 5) Skills and knowledge required; 6) Personal qualities; 7) Amount of travel and any other special conditions or requirements; 8) Salary range; 9) Hours per day or week.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality and Participant Protection / Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: In Section F of your application, you must describe procedures relating to Confidentiality, Participant Protection, and the Protection of Human Subjects Regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS 690 (Certifying on Lobbying)
rubrics_metrics.description: Every grant applicant must have a completed HHS 690 form (PDF) on file with the Department of Health and Human Services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charitable Choice Form - SMA 170 (when applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: This form is required only for programs offering substance abuse prevention or treatment services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants for this program are required to complete the Assurance of Compliance with SAMHSA Charitable Choice Statutes and Regulations Form SMA 170. Delete this if not applicable to your program.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAMHSA Assurances and List of Certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: SAMHSA Assurances for Non-Construction Programs (Form SF-424B) and a List of Certifications pertain to Lobbying, Program Fraud Civil Remedies Act (PFCRA), and Environment Tobacco Smoke.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forms and certification lists are available at SAMHSA links provided in the guide and must be completed as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: FORMS-I vs FORMS-H (which form set to use)
rubrics_metrics.description: The forms in these topics reflect FORMS-I, which must be used for applications with due dates on or after January 25, 2025 (see guide notice NOT-OD-24-086). For due dates on or before January 24, 2025, use FORMS-H.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also see the annotated form set and summary of changes for Forms-I.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Required fields in ASSIST form screens are marked with asterisks (*).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the required fields for each section. Attempting to save without required fields will prevent completion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form save and locking behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST provides Save and Keep Lock, Save and Release Lock, and Cancel and Release Lock options when editing forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Save and Keep Lock keeps the form open for further editing; Save and Release Lock closes the form after saving; Cancel and Release Lock followed by the Continue confirmation returns the form to read-only and does not save any of the entered information. Use the appropriate save option to retain or release editing locks.

rubrics_metrics.name: eRA Commons ID requirement for Senior/Key Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: All personnel listed on the R&R Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) Form must have an eRA Commons ID.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH grant applicants will receive an error if the “Credential, e.g., agency field” is blank or does not contain a valid eRA Commons ID for all personnel on the form. That includes Senior/Key Personnel and Other Significant Contributors. Errors must be corrected before an application can be successfully submitted to the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person Profile – add/edit/remove workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and acceptable methods for adding Senior/Key Persons to the profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add: click Add Sr/Key, then either a) select a name from Add Sr/Key from other component drop-down to choose a person from another component; OR b) enter the eRA Commons ID into the Credential field and click Populate Fields from Credentials to auto-populate information; OR c) manually enter first name, last name, address, and phone. Select a role from Project Role drop-down, complete relevant optional fields, then save using Save and Keep Lock/Save and Release Lock/Save and Add. To remove: click Remove for the person entry and confirm in the pop-up window. Use View and Edit buttons to manage entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget (periods, authority, edit/delete)
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST users with budget authority (View or Edit) may add, edit, and/or view budget information using the R&R Budget tab. Depending on the opportunity, you may be able to add up to five or ten budget periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add Period 1 select Edit and complete budget info (required fields marked *). Use Save and Keep Lock or Save and Release Lock to save. When adding additional budget periods, information from the previous period is carried over and auto-populated and can be edited. To edit, select the period link and click Edit. To delete an entire budget period, select the period link, Edit, then Remove Budget Period and confirm. Viewing cumulative budget: select the Cumulative link to view Research & Related Budget - Cumulative Budget as read-only.

rubrics_metrics.name: R&R Subaward Budget (adding, offline completion, validation, removal)
rubrics_metrics.description: The R&R Subaward Budget form is optional and must be added to the application/component if needed. Applicants can download, complete offline, and upload subaward budget forms into ASSIST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add a subaward select Add New Subaward and complete period budget info (required fields marked *). Repeat Add New Subaward for additional subawards. To add additional periods to a subaward, use Add Period within the subaward form. To complete offline: Download Subaward Form, complete and save locally, then Attach Subaward Form via Browse and Submit. ASSIST validates the PDF to ensure it meets format requirements; files of an invalid format cannot be uploaded. Manage subawards with Edit, Remove, and View buttons. To remove an individual subaward, select Remove and confirm. To remove all subawards, select Remove all Subawards and confirm.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Training Program Plan – Recruitment Plan to Enhance Diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: New in Forms-I: Added Recruitment Plan to Enhance Diversity attachment to Training Program Section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moving this information into a separate attachment means it no longer counts towards the Program Plan page limit.
